full_judgment: 9. Learned Advocates for the opposite parties in these three Rules submit that there is no sufficient cause for condoning the delays. We do not find so. The usual practice is not to entertain a revisional application beyond ninety days. But there is no specific period of Limitation for revision in the Limitation Act and so its residuary Article providing three years limitation is applicable, The expression may be admitted after the period of limitation prescribed there for in section 5 of the Limitation Act means that the extension of time is a matter of concession to the discretion of the court. Considering all these legal positions we do not find any reason to review and set aside the discretion exercised though provisionally at the time of issuance of the Rules.
